But Thou didst sustain me because of innocence
and establish me before Thee for ever.

cross_references.rationale: Being sustained in innocence and established before God corresponds to Psalm16's expectation of appearing before God's face in righteousness. Both join right standing with access to the divine presence.

target_verses.text: But I, in righteousness, will appear before Thy face; I will be satisfied when Thy glory appears.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, Israel’s God, from age to age. May it be! May it be!
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord, Israel’s God,
from age to age.
May it be! May it be!

cross_references.rationale: Both doxologies bless the Lord as Israel's God, extend the blessing across the ages, and conclude with the doubled May it be response.

target_verses.text: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonders!
And blessed be His glorious name for the age and for the age of the age; and the whole earth will be filled with His glory. May it be! May it be!

verses.text: For the end. For understanding, of the sons of Korah.
verses.display_text: For the end. For understanding, of the sons of Korah.

verses.text: As the deer longs for springs of water, so my soul longs for Thee, God.
verses.display_text:
As the deer longs for springs of water,
so my soul longs for Thee, God.

verses.text: My soul thirsted for the living God. When will I come and appear before God’s face?
verses.display_text:
My soul thirsted for the living God.
When will I come and appear before God’s face?

verses.text: My tears became my bread day and night, while it is said to me every day, “Where is your God?”
verses.display_text:
My tears became my bread day and night,
while it is said to me every day, “Where is your God?”

verses.text: These things I remembered and poured out my soul within me: for I will pass through the place of a wonderful tent to God’s house, with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving, a celebrating sound.
verses.display_text:
These things I remembered and poured out my soul within me:
for I will pass through the place of a wonderful tent to God’s house,
with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving,
a celebrating sound.

verses.text: Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me? Hope in God, for I will thank Him: my God is the salvation of my face.
verses.display_text:
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me?
Hope in God, for I will thank Him:
my God is the salvation of my face.

verses.text: My soul was troubled within me; therefore I will remember Thee from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from a small mountain.
Deep calls upon deep at the sound of Thy waterfalls; all Thy billows and Thy waves passed over me.
verses.display_text:
Deep calls upon deep at the sound of Thy waterfalls;
all Thy billows and Thy waves passed over me.

verses.text: By day the Lord will command His mercy, and at night a song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
verses.display_text:
By day the Lord will command His mercy,
and at night a song is with me,
a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.text: I will say to God, “Thou art my supporter; why hast Thou forgotten me? Why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?”
verses.display_text:
I will say to God, “Thou art my supporter; why hast Thou forgotten me?
Why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?”

verses.text: As they crushed my bones, those afflicting me reproached me, saying to me every day, “Where is your God?”
verses.display_text:
As they crushed my bones, those afflicting me reproached me,
saying to me every day, “Where is your God?”

verses.text: Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me? Hope in God, for I will thank Him: my God is the salvation of my face.
verses.display_text:
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me?
Hope in God, for I will thank Him:
my God is the salvation of my face.

verses.text: A psalm of David. Judge me, God, and judge my case against an unholy nation; rescue me from an unjust and deceitful person.
For Thou, God, art my strength; why didst Thou thrust me away? And why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?
verses.display_text:
For Thou, God, art my strength; why didst Thou thrust me away?
And why do I walk downcast while my enemy oppresses me?

verses.text: Send out Thy light and Thy truth; they guided me and brought me to Thy holy mountain and to Thy dwellings.
Then I will go in to God’s altar, to God who gladdens my youth; I will thank Thee with the lyre, God, my God.
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me? Hope in God, for I will thank Him: my God is the salvation of my face.
verses.display_text:
Why are you deeply grieved, soul, and why do you disturb me?
Hope in God, for I will thank Him:
my God is the salvation of my face.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah, for understanding.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah, for understanding.

verses.text: God, with our ears we heard; our fathers announced to us the work Thou didst in their days, in ancient days.
Thy hand destroyed nations, and Thou didst plant our fathers; Thou didst afflict peoples and cast them out.
verses.display_text:
Thy hand destroyed nations, and Thou didst plant our fathers;
Thou didst afflict peoples and cast them out.

verses.text: For they did not inherit the land by their sword, and their arm did not save them, but Thy right hand, Thine arm and the light of Thy face, because Thou didst delight in them.
verses.display_text:
For they did not inherit the land by their sword,
and their arm did not save them,
but Thy right hand, Thine arm and the light of Thy face,
because Thou didst delight in them.

verses.text: Thou Thyself art my King and my God, who commands the salvations of Jacob.
verses.display_text:
Thou Thyself art my King and my God,
who commands the salvations of Jacob.

verses.text: Through Thee we will gore our enemies, and through Thy name we will bring to nothing those rising against us.
verses.display_text:
Through Thee we will gore our enemies,
and through Thy name we will bring to nothing those rising against us.

verses.text: For I will not hope in my bow, and my sword will not save me.
verses.display_text:
For I will not hope in my bow,
and my sword will not save me.

verses.text: For Thou didst save us from those afflicting us and put those who hate us to shame.
verses.display_text:
For Thou didst save us from those afflicting us
and put those who hate us to shame.

verses.text: In God we will be praised all day long, and in Thy name we will give thanks for ever. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
In God we will be praised all day long,
and in Thy name we will give thanks for ever. Diapsalma.

verses.text: But now Thou didst thrust us away and put us to shame, and Thou wilt not go out with our forces.
verses.display_text:
But now Thou didst thrust us away and put us to shame,
and Thou wilt not go out with our forces.

verses.text: Thou didst turn us backward before our enemies, and those who hate us plundered for themselves.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst turn us backward before our enemies,
and those who hate us plundered for themselves.

verses.text: Thou gavest us like sheep for eating and didst scatter us among the nations.
verses.display_text:
Thou gavest us like sheep for eating
and didst scatter us among the nations.

verses.text: Thou soldest Thy people without a price, and there was no abundance in their exchange.
verses.display_text:
Thou soldest Thy people without a price,
and there was no abundance in their exchange.

verses.text: Thou madest us a reproach to our neighbors, scorn and ridicule to those around us.
verses.display_text:
Thou madest us a reproach to our neighbors,
scorn and ridicule to those around us.

verses.text: Thou madest us a parable among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.display_text:
Thou madest us a parable among the nations,
a shaking of the head among the peoples.

verses.text: All day long my humiliation is before me, and the shame of my face covered me,
verses.display_text:
All day long my humiliation is before me,
and the shame of my face covered me,

verses.text: at the voice of one reproaching and speaking abusively, at the presence of an enemy and pursuer.
verses.display_text:
at the voice of one reproaching and speaking abusively,
at the presence of an enemy and pursuer.

verses.text: All these things came upon us, and we did not forget Thee or act unjustly in Thy covenant.
verses.display_text:
All these things came upon us, and we did not forget Thee
or act unjustly in Thy covenant.

verses.text: And our heart did not withdraw backward, but Thou didst turn our paths away from Thy way.
verses.display_text:
And our heart did not withdraw backward,
but Thou didst turn our paths away from Thy way.

verses.text: For Thou didst humble us in a place of affliction, and death’s shadow covered us.
verses.display_text:
For Thou didst humble us in a place of affliction,
and death’s shadow covered us.

verses.text: If we forgot our God’s name, and if we spread our hands toward a foreign god,
verses.display_text:
If we forgot our God’s name,
and if we spread our hands toward a foreign god,

verses.text: will God not search these things out? For He knows the heart’s hidden things.
verses.display_text:
will God not search these things out?
For He knows the heart’s hidden things.

verses.text: For Thy sake we are put to death all day long; we were reckoned as sheep for slaughter.
verses.display_text:
For Thy sake we are put to death all day long;
we were reckoned as sheep for slaughter.

verses.text: Awake! Why dost Thou sleep, Lord? Arise, and do not thrust us away completely.
verses.display_text:
Awake! Why dost Thou sleep, Lord?
Arise, and do not thrust us away completely.

verses.text: Why dost Thou turn Thy face away and forget our poverty and affliction?
verses.display_text:
Why dost Thou turn Thy face away
and forget our poverty and affliction?

verses.text: For our soul was humbled to the dust; our belly clung to the earth.
verses.display_text:
For our soul was humbled to the dust;
our belly clung to the earth.

verses.text: Arise, Lord; help us, and redeem us for the sake of Thy name.
verses.display_text:
Arise, Lord; help us,
and redeem us for the sake of Thy name.

verses.text: For the end, concerning those who will be changed. Of the sons of Korah, for understanding. A song concerning the beloved.
verses.display_text:
For the end, concerning those who will be changed.
Of the sons of Korah, for understanding. A song concerning the beloved.

verses.text: My heart poured forth a good word; I speak my works to the king; my tongue is the reed of a swiftly writing scribe.
Fair in beauty beyond the sons of men, grace was poured upon your lips; therefore God blessed you for ever.
Gird your sword upon your thigh, mighty one, in your fairness and your beauty,
verses.display_text:
Gird your sword upon your thigh, mighty one,
in your fairness and your beauty,

verses.text: and stretch forth, prosper and reign for the sake of truth and meekness and righteousness; your right hand will guide you wondrously.
Your arrows are sharpened, mighty one—peoples will fall beneath you— in the heart of the king’s enemies.
verses.display_text:
Your arrows are sharpened, mighty one—peoples will fall beneath you—
in the heart of the king’s enemies.

verses.text: Your throne, God, is for age upon age; a rod of uprightness is the rod of your kingdom.
verses.display_text:
Your throne, God, is for age upon age;
a rod of uprightness is the rod of your kingdom.

verses.text: You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of exultation beyond your companions.
Myrrh, stacte and cassia come from your garments, from ivory palaces, from which they gladdened you.
verses.display_text:
Myrrh, stacte and cassia come from your garments,
from ivory palaces, from which they gladdened you.

verses.text: Daughters of kings are in your honor; the queen stood at your right in clothing woven with gold, arrayed in varied embroidery.
Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear, and forget your people and your father’s house,
verses.display_text:
Listen, daughter, look and incline your ear,
and forget your people and your father’s house,

verses.text: because the king desired your beauty, because he is your lord.
verses.display_text:
because the king desired your beauty,
because he is your lord.

verses.text: And daughters of Tyre will bow down to him with gifts; the rich of the people will entreat your favor.
verses.display_text:
And daughters of Tyre will bow down to him with gifts;
the rich of the people will entreat your favor.

verses.text: All the glory of the king’s daughter is within; she is arrayed in gold-fringed, varied embroidery.
verses.display_text:
All the glory of the king’s daughter is within;
she is arrayed in gold-fringed, varied embroidery.

verses.text: Virgins behind her will be brought to the king; her companions will be brought unto you.
verses.display_text:
Virgins behind her will be brought to the king;
her companions will be brought unto you.

verses.text: They will be brought with gladness and exultation; they will be led into the king’s sanctuary.
verses.display_text:
They will be brought with gladness and exultation;
they will be led into the king’s sanctuary.

verses.text: In place of your fathers, sons were born unto you; you will establish them as rulers over all the earth.
verses.display_text:
In place of your fathers, sons were born unto you;
you will establish them as rulers over all the earth.

verses.text: They will remember your name in every generation; therefore peoples will thank you for ever and for age upon age.
For the end. Concerning the sons of Korah. A psalm concerning hidden things.
verses.display_text: For the end. Concerning the sons of Korah. A psalm concerning hidden things.

verses.text: Our God is refuge and strength, a helper in the afflictions that have greatly overtaken us.
verses.display_text:
Our God is refuge and strength,
a helper in the afflictions that have greatly overtaken us.

verses.text: Therefore we will not fear when the earth is disturbed and mountains are displaced into the hearts of seas.
verses.display_text:
Therefore we will not fear when the earth is disturbed
and mountains are displaced into the hearts of seas.

verses.text: Their waters roared and were disturbed; the mountains were disturbed at his might. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
Their waters roared and were disturbed;
the mountains were disturbed at his might. Diapsalma.

verses.text: The river’s rushing streams gladden God’s city; the Most High sanctified His dwelling.
verses.display_text:
The river’s rushing streams gladden God’s city;
the Most High sanctified His dwelling.

verses.text: God is in her midst; she will not be shaken; God will help her toward morning.
verses.display_text:
God is in her midst; she will not be shaken;
God will help her toward morning.

verses.text: Nations were disturbed; kingdoms bent; He gave His voice; the earth was shaken.
verses.display_text:
Nations were disturbed; kingdoms bent;
He gave His voice; the earth was shaken.

verses.text: The Lord of powers is with us; Jacob’s God is our supporter. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
The Lord of powers is with us;
Jacob’s God is our supporter. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Come, see the Lord’s works, the wonders He has set upon the earth.
verses.display_text:
Come, see the Lord’s works,
the wonders He has set upon the earth.

verses.text: Bringing wars to an end as far as the earth’s limits, He will shatter a bow and break a weapon apart and burn shields in fire.
verses.display_text:
Bringing wars to an end as far as the earth’s limits,
He will shatter a bow and break a weapon apart
and burn shields in fire.

verses.text: “Cease your activity and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, exalted in the earth.”
verses.display_text:
“Cease your activity and know that I am God;
I will be exalted among the nations, exalted in the earth.”

verses.text: The Lord of powers is with us; Jacob’s God is our supporter.
verses.display_text:
The Lord of powers is with us;
Jacob’s God is our supporter.

verses.text: For the end. A psalm concerning the sons of Korah.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm concerning the sons of Korah.

verses.text: All nations, clap your hands; shout to God with a voice of exultation.
verses.display_text:
All nations, clap your hands;
shout to God with a voice of exultation.

verses.text: For the Lord Most High is fearsome, a great King over all the earth.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord Most High is fearsome,
a great King over all the earth.

verses.text: He subjected peoples to us and nations beneath our feet.
verses.display_text:
He subjected peoples to us
and nations beneath our feet.

verses.text: He chose His inheritance for us, the beauty of Jacob, which He loved. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
He chose His inheritance for us,
the beauty of Jacob, which He loved. Diapsalma.

verses.text: God ascended with a shout of triumph, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.display_text:
God ascended with a shout of triumph,
the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.text: Make music to our God, make music; make music to our King, make music.
verses.display_text:
Make music to our God, make music;
make music to our King, make music.

verses.text: For God is King of all the earth; make music with understanding.
verses.display_text:
For God is King of all the earth;
make music with understanding.

verses.text: God reigned over the nations; God sits upon His holy throne.
verses.display_text:
God reigned over the nations;
God sits upon His holy throne.

verses.text: The rulers of peoples gathered with Abraham’s God; for the mighty of the earth belong to God; they were greatly exalted.
A psalm of song for the sons of Korah, on the second day of the week.
verses.display_text: A psalm of song for the sons of Korah, on the second day of the week.

verses.text: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in our God’s city, His holy mountain,
verses.display_text:
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised
in our God’s city, His holy mountain,

verses.text: taking good root for the exultation of all the earth. Zion’s mountains, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.display_text:
taking good root for the exultation of all the earth.
Zion’s mountains, the sides of the north,
the city of the great King.

verses.text: God is known in her citadels when He supports her.
verses.display_text: God is known in her citadels when He supports her.

verses.text: For behold, the kings gathered; they came together.
verses.display_text:
For behold, the kings gathered;
they came together.

verses.text: They saw and thus marveled; they were troubled and shaken.
verses.display_text:
They saw and thus marveled;
they were troubled and shaken.

verses.text: Trembling seized them; there were pangs like a woman giving birth.
verses.display_text:
Trembling seized them;
there were pangs like a woman giving birth.

verses.text: With a violent wind Thou wilt shatter the ships of Tarshish.
verses.display_text: With a violent wind Thou wilt shatter the ships of Tarshish.

verses.text: Just as we heard, so we saw in the city of the Lord of powers, in our God’s city; God founded her for ever. Diapsalma.
We received Thy mercy, God, in the midst of Thy sanctuary.
verses.display_text:
We received Thy mercy, God,
in the midst of Thy sanctuary.

verses.text: According to Thy name, God, so also Thy praise reaches the earth’s limits; Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion rejoice; let Judea’s daughters exult because of Thy judgments, Lord.
verses.display_text:
Let Mount Zion rejoice;
let Judea’s daughters exult because of Thy judgments, Lord.

verses.text: Encircle Zion and encompass her; recount in her towers,
verses.display_text:
Encircle Zion and encompass her;
recount in her towers,

verses.text: set your hearts upon her strength and divide her citadels, so that you may tell another generation.
verses.display_text:
set your hearts upon her strength
and divide her citadels,
so that you may tell another generation.

verses.text: For this is God, our God for ever and for age upon age; He will shepherd us through the ages.
For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
verses.display_text: For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah.

verses.text: Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all who inhabit the world,
verses.display_text:
Hear these things, all nations;
give ear, all who inhabit the world,

verses.text: both the earthborn and the sons of men, rich and poor together.
verses.display_text:
both the earthborn and the sons of men,
rich and poor together.

verses.text: My mouth will speak wisdom, and my heart’s meditation understanding.
verses.display_text:
My mouth will speak wisdom,
and my heart’s meditation understanding.

verses.text: I will incline my ear to a parable; with a psaltery I will open my riddle.
verses.display_text:
I will incline my ear to a parable;
with a psaltery I will open my riddle.

verses.text: Why do I fear in an evil day? The lawlessness of my heel will surround me.
verses.display_text:
Why do I fear in an evil day?
The lawlessness of my heel will surround me.

verses.text: Those trusting in their strength and boasting in the abundance of their wealth,
verses.display_text:
Those trusting in their strength
and boasting in the abundance of their wealth,

verses.text: A brother does not redeem; will a person redeem? He will not give God his atonement price
verses.display_text:
A brother does not redeem; will a person redeem?
He will not give God his atonement price

verses.text: and the price of the redemption of his soul.
verses.display_text: and the price of the redemption of his soul.

verses.text: And he ceased for ever and will live to the end, for he will not see corruption when he sees wise people dying.
verses.display_text:
And he ceased for ever and will live to the end,
for he will not see corruption when he sees wise people dying.

verses.text: The foolish and senseless will perish together and leave their wealth to strangers.
verses.display_text:
The foolish and senseless will perish together
and leave their wealth to strangers.

verses.text: Their tombs are their houses for ever, their dwellings from generation to generation; they invoked their names upon their lands.
A person, though in honor, did not understand; he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.
verses.display_text:
A person, though in honor, did not understand;
he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.

verses.text: This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them, and afterward they will take delight with their mouth. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
This way of theirs is a stumbling block to them,
and afterward they will take delight with their mouth. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Like sheep they were placed in Hades; death shepherds them. The upright will rule over them in the morning, and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.
verses.display_text:
Like sheep they were placed in Hades; death shepherds them.
The upright will rule over them in the morning,
and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.

verses.text: But God will redeem my soul from Hades’ hand when He receives me. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
But God will redeem my soul from Hades’ hand
when He receives me. Diapsalma.

verses.text: Do not fear when a person grows rich and when the glory of his house increases.
verses.display_text:
Do not fear when a person grows rich
and when the glory of his house increases.

verses.text: For when he dies he will not take everything, nor will his glory descend with him.
verses.display_text:
For when he dies he will not take everything,
nor will his glory descend with him.

verses.text: For his soul will be blessed during his lifetime; he will thank you when you do good to him.
verses.display_text:
For his soul will be blessed during his lifetime;
he will thank you when you do good to him.

verses.text: He will enter as far as the generation of his fathers; he will never see light.
verses.display_text:
He will enter as far as the generation of his fathers;
he will never see light.

verses.text: A person, though in honor, did not understand; he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.
verses.display_text:
A person, though in honor, did not understand;
he was compared to senseless beasts and made like them.

verses.text: A psalm of Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and summoned the earth from the sun’s risings to its settings.
verses.display_text:
A psalm of Asaph.
The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and summoned the earth
from the sun’s risings to its settings.

verses.text: From Zion comes the splendor of His beauty; God will come manifestly,
verses.display_text:
From Zion comes the splendor of His beauty;
God will come manifestly,

verses.text: our God, and He will not keep silent; fire will burn before Him, and around Him is a mighty tempest.
He will summon heaven above and the earth, to judge His people.
verses.display_text:
He will summon heaven above
and the earth, to judge His people.

verses.text: Gather His holy ones to Him, those who establish His covenant over sacrifices.
verses.display_text:
Gather His holy ones to Him,
those who establish His covenant over sacrifices.

verses.text: The heavens will announce His righteousness, for God is judge. Diapsalma.
verses.display_text:
The heavens will announce His righteousness,
for God is judge. Diapsalma.

verses.text: “Hear, My people, and I will speak unto you; Israel, I testify unto you. I am God, your God.
I will not rebuke you concerning your sacrifices; your burnt offerings are continually before Me.
verses.display_text:
I will not rebuke you concerning your sacrifices;
your burnt offerings are continually before Me.

verses.text: I will not receive calves from your house or young goats from your flocks.
verses.display_text:
I will not receive calves from your house
or young goats from your flocks.

verses.text: For all the forest’s wild animals are Mine, beasts on the mountains and cattle.
verses.display_text:
For all the forest’s wild animals are Mine,
beasts on the mountains and cattle.

verses.text: I know all the birds of heaven, and the field’s beauty is with Me.
verses.display_text:
I know all the birds of heaven,
and the field’s beauty is with Me.

verses.text: If I become hungry, I will certainly not tell you, for the inhabited world and its fullness are Mine.
verses.display_text:
If I become hungry, I will certainly not tell you,
for the inhabited world and its fullness are Mine.

verses.text: Will I eat bulls’ flesh or drink goats’ blood?
verses.display_text:
Will I eat bulls’ flesh
or drink goats’ blood?

I was stuck in the mud of the depth, with no firm ground;
I entered the sea’s depths, and a tempest drowned me.

verses.text: I grew weary crying out; my throat became hoarse; my eyes failed from hoping in my God.
verses.display_text:
I grew weary crying out; my throat became hoarse;
my eyes failed from hoping in my God.

verses.text: More numerous than the hairs on my head became those hating me without cause; my enemies pursuing me unjustly became strong. What I did not plunder, I was then repaying.
God, Thou knewest my folly, and my offenses were not concealed from Thee.
verses.display_text:
God, Thou knewest my folly,
and my offenses were not concealed from Thee.

verses.text: May those waiting for Thee not be ashamed because of me, Lord, Lord of powers; may those seeking Thee not be embarrassed because of me, God of Israel,
verses.display_text:
May those waiting for Thee not be ashamed because of me,
Lord, Lord of powers;
may those seeking Thee not be embarrassed because of me,
God of Israel,

verses.text: for on Thine account I endured reproach; embarrassment covered my face.
verses.display_text:
for on Thine account I endured reproach;
embarrassment covered my face.

verses.text: I became estranged from my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
verses.display_text:
I became estranged from my brothers
and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,

verses.text: for zeal for Thy house devoured me, and the reproaches of those reproaching Thee fell upon me.
verses.display_text:
for zeal for Thy house devoured me,
and the reproaches of those reproaching Thee fell upon me.

verses.text: I bowed my soul down in fasting, and it became a reproach to me.
verses.display_text:
I bowed my soul down in fasting,
and it became a reproach to me.

verses.text: I made sackcloth my garment, and became a proverb to them.
verses.display_text:
I made sackcloth my garment,
and became a proverb to them.

verses.text: Those sitting in the gate talked against me, and wine-drinkers sang about me.
verses.display_text:
Those sitting in the gate talked against me,
and wine-drinkers sang about me.

verses.text: But I, in my prayer, turn toward Thee, Lord; a time of favor, God, in the abundance of Thy mercy. Hear me in the truth of Thy salvation.
Save me from clay so that I may not become stuck; may I be rescued from those hating me and from the depth of waters.
verses.display_text:
Save me from clay so that I may not become stuck;
may I be rescued from those hating me and from the depth of waters.

verses.text: Let no tempest of water drown me, nor the depth swallow me; let no well close its mouth over me.
Hear me, Lord, for Thy mercy is kind; according to Thine abundant compassions, look upon me.
verses.display_text:
Hear me, Lord, for Thy mercy is kind;
according to Thine abundant compassions, look upon me.

verses.text: Do not turn Thy face away from Thy servant; for I am afflicted, hear me quickly.
verses.display_text:
Do not turn Thy face away from Thy servant;
for I am afflicted, hear me quickly.

verses.text: Attend to my soul and redeem it; because of my enemies, rescue me.
verses.display_text:
Attend to my soul and redeem it;
because of my enemies, rescue me.

verses.text: For Thou knowest my reproach, shame and embarrassment; all those afflicting me are before Thee.
verses.display_text:
For Thou knowest my reproach, shame and embarrassment;
all those afflicting me are before Thee.

verses.text: My soul expected reproach and misery; I waited for someone to grieve with me, but there was none, for comforters, but found none.
They gave gall for my food, and for my thirst made me drink sour wine.
verses.display_text:
They gave gall for my food,
and for my thirst made me drink sour wine.

verses.text: Let their table before them become a trap, a repayment and a stumbling block.
verses.display_text:
Let their table before them become a trap,
a repayment and a stumbling block.

verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and bend their back down continually.
verses.display_text:
Let their eyes be darkened so they cannot see,
and bend their back down continually.

verses.text: Pour Thine anger upon them; may the fury of Thine anger seize them.
verses.display_text:
Pour Thine anger upon them;
may the fury of Thine anger seize them.

verses.text: Let their homestead become deserted; let no one dwell in their dwellings.
verses.display_text:
Let their homestead become deserted;
let no one dwell in their dwellings.

verses.text: For they persecuted the one Thou didst strike, and added to the pain of Thy wounded.
verses.display_text:
For they persecuted the one Thou didst strike,
and added to the pain of Thy wounded.

verses.text: Add lawlessness to their lawlessness, and let them not enter Thy righteousness.
verses.display_text:
Add lawlessness to their lawlessness,
and let them not enter Thy righteousness.

verses.text: Let them be erased from the book of the living, and let them not be written with the righteous.
verses.display_text:
Let them be erased from the book of the living,
and let them not be written with the righteous.

verses.text: I am poor and in pain, and the salvation of Thy presence, God, supported me.
verses.display_text:
I am poor and in pain,
and the salvation of Thy presence, God, supported me.

verses.text: I will praise God’s name with a song and magnify Him in praise,
verses.display_text:
I will praise God’s name with a song
and magnify Him in praise,

verses.text: and it will please God more than a young calf bringing forth horns and hoofs.
verses.display_text:
and it will please God more than a young calf
bringing forth horns and hoofs.

verses.text: Let the poor see and rejoice; seek God, and your soul will live,
verses.display_text:
Let the poor see and rejoice;
seek God, and your soul will live,

verses.text: for the Lord heard the needy and did not despise His bound ones.
verses.display_text:
for the Lord heard the needy
and did not despise His bound ones.

verses.text: Let the heavens and earth praise Him, the sea and everything creeping in them.
verses.display_text:
Let the heavens and earth praise Him,
the sea and everything creeping in them.

verses.text: For God will save Zion, and Judea’s cities will be built; they will dwell there and inherit it.
His servants’ offspring will possess it, and those loving His name will dwell in it.
verses.display_text:
His servants’ offspring will possess it,
and those loving His name will dwell in it.

verses.text: For the end. Of David. For remembrance,
verses.display_text: For the end. Of David. For remembrance,

verses.text: for the Lord to save me. God, attend to my help!
verses.display_text:
for the Lord to save me.
God, attend to my help!

verses.text: May those seeking my soul be ashamed and confounded; may those wishing me evil turn backward and be disgraced.
verses.display_text:
May those seeking my soul be ashamed and confounded;
may those wishing me evil turn backward and be disgraced.

verses.text: May those saying to me, “Well! Well!” turn back immediately in shame.
verses.display_text:
May those saying to me, “Well! Well!”
turn back immediately in shame.

verses.text: Let all who seek Thee exult and be glad in Thee; let those who love Thy salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
But I am poor and needy; God, help me! Thou art my helper and my rescuer; Lord, do not delay!
Of David; of the sons of Jonadab and of those first taken captive. God, in Thee I have hoped; may I never be disgraced.
In Thy righteousness rescue me and bring me out; bend Thine ear toward me and save me.
verses.display_text:
In Thy righteousness rescue me and bring me out;
bend Thine ear toward me and save me.

verses.text: Become for me a defending God and a fortified place to save me, for Thou art my firm support and my refuge.
verses.display_text:
Become for me a defending God
and a fortified place to save me,
for Thou art my firm support and my refuge.

verses.text: My God, rescue me from a sinner’s hand, from the hand of one acting lawlessly and unjustly.
verses.display_text:
My God, rescue me from a sinner’s hand,
from the hand of one acting lawlessly and unjustly.

verses.text: For Thou art my endurance, Lord; the Lord is my hope from my youth.
verses.display_text:
For Thou art my endurance, Lord;
the Lord is my hope from my youth.

verses.text: Upon Thee I was supported from the womb; from my mother’s belly Thou art the One who shelters me. My hymn is continually in Thee.
I became like a portent to the many, and Thou art a mighty helper.
verses.display_text:
I became like a portent to the many,
and Thou art a mighty helper.

verses.text: Let my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may sing of Thy glory, Thy majesty all day.
verses.display_text:
Let my mouth be filled with praise,
so that I may sing of Thy glory,
Thy majesty all day.

verses.text: Do not cast me away at the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.
verses.display_text:
Do not cast me away at the time of old age;
when my strength fails, do not forsake me.

verses.text: For my enemies spoke to me, and those watching my soul plotted together,
verses.display_text:
For my enemies spoke to me,
and those watching my soul plotted together,

verses.text: saying, “God has forsaken him! Pursue him and overtake him, for there is no rescuer!”
verses.display_text:
saying, “God has forsaken him!
Pursue him and overtake him,
for there is no rescuer!”

verses.text: God, do not go far from me; my God, attend to my help!
verses.display_text:
God, do not go far from me;
my God, attend to my help!

verses.text: Let those slandering my soul be ashamed and fail; let those seeking evil for me wrap themselves in shame and confusion.
verses.display_text:
Let those slandering my soul be ashamed and fail;
let those seeking evil for me wrap themselves in shame and confusion.

verses.text: But I will always hope, and add to all Thy praise.
verses.display_text:
But I will always hope,
and add to all Thy praise.

verses.text: My mouth will proclaim Thy righteousness, Thy salvation all day, for I did not know literary learning.
verses.display_text:
My mouth will proclaim Thy righteousness,
Thy salvation all day,
for I did not know literary learning.

verses.text: I will enter in the Lord’s power; Lord, I will remember Thy righteousness alone.
verses.display_text:
I will enter in the Lord’s power;
Lord, I will remember Thy righteousness alone.

verses.text: Thou didst teach me, God, from my youth, and until now I will announce Thy wonders.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst teach me, God, from my youth,
and until now I will announce Thy wonders.

verses.text: And until old age and advanced years, God, do not forsake me, until I announce Thine arm to the whole coming generation, Thy power and Thy righteousness—
verses.display_text:
And until old age and advanced years, God, do not forsake me,
until I announce Thine arm to the whole coming generation,
Thy power and Thy righteousness—

verses.text: God, up to the highest—what great things Thou hast done! God, who is like Thee?
verses.display_text:
God, up to the highest—what great things Thou hast done!
God, who is like Thee?

verses.text: How many troubles, many and grievous, Thou didst show me! And turning back, Thou madest me live, and from the depths of the earth Thou broughtest me up again.
verses.display_text:
How many troubles, many and grievous, Thou didst show me!
And turning back, Thou madest me live,
and from the depths of the earth Thou broughtest me up again.

verses.text: Thou didst increase Thy greatness, and turning back, didst comfort me, and from the depths of the earth Thou broughtest me up again.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst increase Thy greatness,
and turning back, didst comfort me,
and from the depths of the earth Thou broughtest me up again.

verses.text: For I too will acknowledge unto Thee Thy truth with a musical instrument, God; I will sing unto Thee with a lyre, Holy One of Israel.
My lips will exult when I sing unto Thee, and my soul, which Thou didst redeem.
verses.display_text:
My lips will exult when I sing unto Thee,
and my soul, which Thou didst redeem.

verses.text: And my tongue too will meditate on Thy righteousness all day, when those seeking evil for me become ashamed and confounded.
verses.display_text:
And my tongue too will meditate on Thy righteousness all day,
when those seeking evil for me become ashamed and confounded.

verses.text: For Solomon. God, give Thy judgment to the king, and Thy righteousness to the king’s son,
verses.display_text:
For Solomon.
God, give Thy judgment to the king,
and Thy righteousness to the king’s son,

verses.text: to judge Thy people in righteousness, and Thy poor in justice.
verses.display_text:
to judge Thy people in righteousness,
and Thy poor in justice.

verses.text: Let the mountains take up peace for Thy people, and the hills in righteousness.
verses.display_text:
Let the mountains take up peace for Thy people,
and the hills in righteousness.

verses.text: He will judge the poor of the people, and save the children of the needy, and humble the false accuser,
verses.display_text:
He will judge the poor of the people,
and save the children of the needy,
and humble the false accuser,

verses.text: and he will endure alongside the sun, and before the moon, through generations of generations.
verses.display_text:
and he will endure alongside the sun,
and before the moon, through generations of generations.

verses.text: And he will descend like rain upon a fleece, and like drops dripping upon the earth.
verses.display_text:
And he will descend like rain upon a fleece,
and like drops dripping upon the earth.

verses.text: Righteousness will arise in his days, and abundant peace until the moon is taken away.
verses.display_text:
Righteousness will arise in his days,
and abundant peace until the moon is taken away.

verses.text: And he will rule from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the inhabited world.
verses.display_text:
And he will rule from sea to sea,
and from the river to the ends of the inhabited world.

verses.text: Ethiopians will fall before him, and his enemies will lick dust.
verses.display_text:
Ethiopians will fall before him,
and his enemies will lick dust.

verses.text: kings of Tarshish and the islands will offer gifts; kings of the Arabians and Saba will bring gifts.
verses.display_text:
kings of Tarshish and the islands will offer gifts;
kings of the Arabians and Saba will bring gifts.

verses.text: And all kings will bow before him; all nations will serve him.
verses.display_text:
And all kings will bow before him;
all nations will serve him.

verses.text: For he rescued a poor person from a powerful man’s hand, and a needy person who had no helper.
verses.display_text:
For he rescued a poor person from a powerful man’s hand,
and a needy person who had no helper.

verses.text: He will spare the poor and needy, and save the souls of the needy.
verses.display_text:
He will spare the poor and needy,
and save the souls of the needy.

verses.text: From interest-taking and injustice he will redeem their souls, and their name is honored before him.
verses.display_text:
From interest-taking and injustice he will redeem their souls,
and their name is honored before him.

verses.text: And he will live, and some of Arabia’s gold will be given to him; and they will pray concerning him continually, and bless him all day.
There will be a firm support in the land upon the mountain summits; his fruit will be raised far above Lebanon, and they will blossom from the city like the earth’s grass.
Let his name be blessed through the ages; before the sun his name will endure. And all the tribes of the earth will be blessed in him; all nations will call him blessed.
Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonders!
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel,
who alone does wonders!

verses.text: And blessed be His glorious name for the age and for the age of the age; and the whole earth will be filled with His glory. May it be! May it be!
The hymns of David son of Jesse have ended.
verses.display_text: The hymns of David son of Jesse have ended.

verses.text: A psalm of Asaph. How good God is to Israel, to those upright in heart!
verses.display_text:
A psalm of Asaph.
How good God is to Israel,
to those upright in heart!

verses.text: But my feet were almost shaken; my steps were nearly poured out.
verses.display_text:
But my feet were almost shaken;
my steps were nearly poured out.

verses.text: For I envied the lawless, beholding sinners’ peace,
verses.display_text:
For I envied the lawless,
beholding sinners’ peace,

verses.text: for there is no refusal at their death, and firmness in their scourging.
verses.display_text:
for there is no refusal at their death,
and firmness in their scourging.

verses.text: They are not in human toils, and they will not be scourged with humans.
verses.display_text:
They are not in human toils,
and they will not be scourged with humans.

verses.text: Therefore arrogance seized them; they wrapped themselves in their injustice and ungodliness.
verses.display_text:
Therefore arrogance seized them;
they wrapped themselves in their injustice and ungodliness.

verses.text: Their injustice will come out as though from fat; they passed into a disposition of heart.
verses.display_text:
Their injustice will come out as though from fat;
they passed into a disposition of heart.

verses.text: They devised and spoke in wickedness; they spoke injustice against the height.
verses.display_text:
They devised and spoke in wickedness;
they spoke injustice against the height.

verses.text: They set their mouth toward heaven, and their tongue passed over the earth.
verses.display_text:
They set their mouth toward heaven,
and their tongue passed over the earth.

verses.text: Therefore my people will return here, and full days will be found for them.
verses.display_text:
Therefore my people will return here,
and full days will be found for them.

verses.text: And they said, “How did God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?”
verses.display_text:
And they said, “How did God know?
And is there knowledge in the Most High?”

verses.text: Behold, these are sinners, and they prosper; for the age they took possession of wealth.
verses.display_text:
Behold, these are sinners, and they prosper;
for the age they took possession of wealth.

verses.text: And I said, “Then in vain I made my heart righteous and washed my hands among the innocent;
verses.display_text:
And I said, “Then in vain I made my heart righteous
and washed my hands among the innocent;

verses.text: and I became scourged all day, and my rebuke comes in the mornings.”
verses.display_text:
and I became scourged all day,
and my rebuke comes in the mornings.”

verses.text: If I were saying, “I will recount it thus,” behold, I would have broken faith with the generation of Thy sons.
verses.display_text:
If I were saying, “I will recount it thus,”
behold, I would have broken faith with the generation of Thy sons.

verses.text: And I undertook to understand this; it is toil before me,
verses.display_text:
And I undertook to understand this;
it is toil before me,

verses.text: until I enter God’s sanctuary and understand their last things.
verses.display_text:
until I enter God’s sanctuary
and understand their last things.

verses.text: Nevertheless, because of their deceits Thou didst set things for them; Thou didst cast them down when they were lifted up.
verses.display_text:
Nevertheless, because of their deceits Thou didst set things for them;
Thou didst cast them down when they were lifted up.

verses.text: How they became desolate suddenly! They failed; they perished through their lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
How they became desolate suddenly!
They failed; they perished through their lawlessness.

verses.text: Like the dream of someone awakening, Lord, in Thy city Thou wilt count their image as nothing.
verses.display_text:
Like the dream of someone awakening,
Lord, in Thy city Thou wilt count their image as nothing.

verses.text: For my heart was set ablaze, and my kidneys were altered,
verses.display_text:
For my heart was set ablaze,
and my kidneys were altered,

verses.text: and I was counted as nothing and did not understand; I became beastlike beside Thee.
verses.display_text:
and I was counted as nothing and did not understand;
I became beastlike beside Thee.

verses.text: And I am continually with Thee; Thou didst grasp my right hand.
verses.display_text:
And I am continually with Thee;
Thou didst grasp my right hand.

verses.text: In Thy counsel Thou didst guide me, and with glory Thou didst receive me.
verses.display_text:
In Thy counsel Thou didst guide me,
and with glory Thou didst receive me.

verses.text: For what is there for me in heaven? And what did I desire from Thee upon the earth?
verses.display_text:
For what is there for me in heaven?
And what did I desire from Thee upon the earth?

verses.text: My heart and my flesh failed; the God of my heart and my portion is God for ever.
verses.display_text:
My heart and my flesh failed;
the God of my heart and my portion is God for ever.

verses.text: For behold, those distancing themselves from Thee will perish; Thou didst destroy everyone who goes whoring away from Thee.
verses.display_text:
For behold, those distancing themselves from Thee will perish;
Thou didst destroy everyone who goes whoring away from Thee.

verses.text: But for me, clinging to God is good, to set my hope in the Lord, to proclaim all Thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
verses.display_text:
But for me, clinging to God is good,
to set my hope in the Lord,
to proclaim all Thy praises
in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

verses.text: Of understanding. Of Asaph. Why, God, didst Thou reject to the end? Why was Thy wrath angry against the sheep of Thy pasture?
verses.display_text:
Of understanding. Of Asaph.
Why, God, didst Thou reject to the end?
Why was Thy wrath angry against the sheep of Thy pasture?

verses.text: Remember Thy congregation, which Thou didst acquire from the beginning; Thou didst redeem the rod of Thine inheritance, this Mount Zion, where Thou didst encamp.
Raise Thy hands against their arrogance to the end, for all the evil the enemy did in Thy holy places.
verses.display_text:
Raise Thy hands against their arrogance to the end,
for all the evil the enemy did in Thy holy places.

verses.text: And those hating Thee boasted within Thy feast; they set their signs as signs, and did not understand.
verses.display_text:
And those hating Thee boasted within Thy feast;
they set their signs as signs, and did not understand.

verses.text: As though into the entrance above,
verses.display_text: As though into the entrance above,

verses.text: as in a forest of trees, with axes they cut out her doors; together with axe and stone-cutting tool they tore her down.
verses.display_text:
as in a forest of trees, with axes they cut out her doors;
together with axe and stone-cutting tool they tore her down.

verses.text: They burned Thy sanctuary with fire; they profaned the tent of Thy name to the ground.
verses.display_text:
They burned Thy sanctuary with fire;
they profaned the tent of Thy name to the ground.

verses.text: Their kindred said in their hearts together, “Come, let us burn all God’s feasts from the earth!”
verses.display_text:
Their kindred said in their hearts together,
“Come, let us burn all God’s feasts from the earth!”

verses.text: We did not see our signs; there is no prophet any longer, and he will know us no longer.
How long, God, will the enemy reproach? Will the adversary provoke Thy name to the end?
verses.display_text:
How long, God, will the enemy reproach?
Will the adversary provoke Thy name to the end?

verses.text: Why dost Thou turn away Thy hand and Thy right hand from within Thy bosom to the end?
verses.display_text:
Why dost Thou turn away Thy hand

verses.text: But God is our King before the age; He worked salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.display_text:
But God is our King before the age;
He worked salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.text: Thou didst strengthen the sea by Thy power; Thou didst crush the dragons’ heads upon the water.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst strengthen the sea by Thy power;
Thou didst crush the dragons’ heads upon the water.

verses.display_text:
Thou didst crush the dragon’s heads;
Thou gavest him as food to the Ethiopian peoples.

verses.text: Thou didst break open springs and torrents; Thou didst dry up rivers of Etham.
verses.display_text:
Thou didst break open springs and torrents;
Thou didst dry up rivers of Etham.

verses.text: Thine is the day, and Thine is the night; Thou didst fashion light and the sun.
verses.display_text:
Thine is the day, and Thine is the night;

verses.display_text:
Thou madest all the earth’s boundaries;
summer and spring—Thou didst shape them.

verses.text: Remember this: an enemy reproached the Lord, and a foolish people provoked Thy name.
verses.display_text:
Remember this: an enemy reproached the Lord,
and a foolish people provoked Thy name.

verses.text: Do not hand over to wild beasts a soul acknowledging Thee; do not forget Thy needy ones’ souls to the end.
verses.display_text:
Do not hand over to wild beasts a soul acknowledging Thee;
do not forget Thy needy ones’ souls to the end.

verses.text: Look upon Thy covenant, for the darkened ones of the earth were filled with houses of lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
Look upon Thy covenant,
for the darkened ones of the earth were filled with houses of lawlessness.

verses.text: Let a humbled person not turn back disgraced; the poor and needy will praise Thy name.
verses.display_text:
Let a humbled person not turn back disgraced;
the poor and needy will praise Thy name.

verses.text: Arise, God, judge Thy case; remember the reproaches against Thee by a fool all day.
verses.display_text:
Arise, God, judge Thy case;
remember the reproaches against Thee by a fool all day.

verses.text: Do not forget Thy suppliants’ voice; the arrogance of those hating Thee ascended continually toward Thee.
verses.display_text:
Do not forget Thy suppliants’ voice;
the arrogance of those hating Thee ascended continually toward Thee.

verses.text: For the end. Do not destroy. A psalm of Asaph, of song.
verses.display_text:
For the end. Do not destroy.
A psalm of Asaph, of song.

verses.text: We will acknowledge Thee, God; we will acknowledge and call upon Thy name.
verses.display_text:
We will acknowledge Thee, God;
we will acknowledge and call upon Thy name.

verses.text: I will recount all Thy wonders when I take an appointed time; I will judge uprightness.
verses.display_text:
I will recount all Thy wonders when I take an appointed time;

verses.text: The earth and all who inhabit it melted; I established its pillars. Diapsalma.
I said to those acting lawlessly, “Do not act lawlessly,” and to those sinning, “Do not raise a horn;
verses.display_text:
I said to those acting lawlessly, “Do not act lawlessly,”
and to those sinning, “Do not raise a horn;

and prosperity within your fortified towers.

verses.text: For the sake of my brothers and neighbors, I was speaking peace concerning you.
verses.display_text:
For the sake of my brothers and neighbors,
I was speaking peace concerning you.

verses.text: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I sought good things for you.
verses.display_text:
For the sake of the house of the Lord our God,
I sought good things for you.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. To Thee I lifted my eyes, Thou who dwellest in heaven.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
To Thee I lifted my eyes,
Thou who dwellest in heaven.

verses.text: Behold, as slaves’ eyes turn to their masters’ hands, as a slave woman’s eyes turn to her mistress’s hands, so our eyes turn to the Lord our God, until He has compassion on us.
verses.display_text:
Behold, as slaves’ eyes turn to their masters’ hands,
as a slave woman’s eyes turn to her mistress’s hands,
so our eyes turn to the Lord our God,
until He has compassion on us.

verses.text: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, for we have been filled with contempt to excess,
verses.display_text:
Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us,
for we have been filled with contempt to excess,

verses.text: Our soul has been filled beyond measure. Reproach for those who prosper, and contempt for the proud.
verses.display_text:
Our soul has been filled beyond measure.
Reproach for those who prosper,
and contempt for the proud.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. Had the Lord not been among us— let Israel now say—
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
Had the Lord not been among us—
let Israel now say—

verses.text: had the Lord not been among us when people rose against us,
verses.display_text:
had the Lord not been among us
when people rose against us,

verses.text: then they would have swallowed us alive when their fury was kindled against us.
verses.display_text:
then they would have swallowed us alive
when their fury was kindled against us.

verses.text: Then the water drowned us; our soul passed through a torrent.
verses.display_text:
Then the water drowned us;
our soul passed through a torrent.

verses.text: Then our soul passed through the irresistible water.
verses.display_text:
Then our soul passed through
the irresistible water.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord,
who did not give us as prey to their teeth.

verses.text: Our soul was rescued like a little bird from the trap of hunters; the trap was shattered, and we were rescued.
Our help is in the Lord’s name, who made heaven and earth.
verses.display_text:
Our help is in the Lord’s name,
who made heaven and earth.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. Those trusting in the Lord are like Mount Zion; the one dwelling in Jerusalem will never be shaken.
Mountains are around her, and the Lord is around His people, from now and for ever.
verses.display_text:
Mountains are around her,
and the Lord is around His people,
from now and for ever.

verses.text: For He will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the righteous, so that the righteous may not stretch out their hands in lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
For He will not leave the rod of sinners
upon the lot of the righteous,
so that the righteous may not stretch out
their hands in lawlessness.

verses.text: Do good, Lord, to the good and to those upright in heart.
verses.display_text:
Do good, Lord, to the good
and to those upright in heart.

verses.text: But those turning aside into tangled ways— the Lord will lead them away with workers of lawlessness. Peace upon Israel.
verses.display_text:
But those turning aside into tangled ways—
the Lord will lead them away with workers of lawlessness.
Peace upon Israel.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. When the Lord turned back Zion’s captivity, we became like those comforted.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
When the Lord turned back Zion’s captivity,
we became like those comforted.

verses.text: Then our mouth was filled with joy and our tongue with exultation. Then they will say among the nations, “The Lord has done great things with them.”
verses.display_text:
Then our mouth was filled with joy
and our tongue with exultation.
Then they will say among the nations,
“The Lord has done great things with them.”

verses.text: The Lord has done great things with us; we became glad.
verses.display_text:
The Lord has done great things with us;
we became glad.

verses.text: Turn back our captivity, Lord, like torrents in the south.
verses.display_text:
Turn back our captivity, Lord,
like torrents in the south.

verses.text: Those sowing in tears will reap with exultation.
verses.display_text:
Those sowing in tears
will reap with exultation.

verses.text: Going, they went and wept, carrying their seeds; but coming, they will arrive with exultation, carrying their sheaves.
verses.display_text:
Going, they went and wept,
carrying their seeds;
but coming, they will arrive with exultation,
carrying their sheaves.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. For Solomon. Unless the Lord builds a house, those building it have labored in vain. Unless the Lord guards a city, the watchman has kept awake in vain.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents. For Solomon.
Unless the Lord builds a house,
those building it have labored in vain.
Unless the Lord guards a city,
the watchman has kept awake in vain.

verses.text: It is vain for you to rise early, to get up after sitting down, you who eat bread of pain, when He gives sleep to His beloved ones.
verses.display_text:
It is vain for you to rise early,
to get up after sitting down,
you who eat bread of pain,
when He gives sleep to His beloved ones.

verses.text: Behold, sons are the Lord’s inheritance, the reward of the fruit of the womb.
verses.display_text:
Behold, sons are the Lord’s inheritance,
the reward of the fruit of the womb.

verses.text: Like arrows in a mighty man’s hand, so are the sons of those who have been cast out.
verses.display_text:
Like arrows in a mighty man’s hand,
so are the sons of those who have been cast out.

verses.text: Happy is the person who will fill his desire with them. They will not be put to shame when they speak with their enemies at the gate.
verses.display_text:
Happy is the person who will fill his desire with them.
They will not be put to shame
when they speak with their enemies at the gate.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. Happy are all who fear the Lord, who walk in His ways.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
Happy are all who fear the Lord,
who walk in His ways.

verses.text: You will eat the labors of your wrists; happy are you, and it will be well with you.
verses.display_text:
You will eat the labors of your wrists;
happy are you, and it will be well with you.

verses.text: Your wife is like a flourishing vine in the sides of your house; your sons are like newly planted olive trees around your table.
verses.display_text:
Your wife is like a flourishing vine
in the sides of your house;
your sons are like newly planted olive trees
around your table.

verses.text: Behold, thus will the person be blessed who fears the Lord.
verses.display_text:
Behold, thus will the person be blessed
who fears the Lord.

verses.text: May the Lord bless you from Zion, and may you see Jerusalem’s good things all the days of your life.
verses.display_text:
May the Lord bless you from Zion,
and may you see Jerusalem’s good things
all the days of your life.

verses.text: And may you see sons of your sons. Peace upon Israel.
verses.display_text:
And may you see sons of your sons.
Peace upon Israel.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. Many times they fought against me from my youth— let Israel now say—
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
Many times they fought against me from my youth—
let Israel now say—

verses.text: many times they fought against me from my youth, and indeed they did not prevail over me.
verses.display_text:
many times they fought against me from my youth,
and indeed they did not prevail over me.

verses.text: On my back sinners worked; they prolonged their lawlessness.
verses.display_text:
On my back sinners worked;
they prolonged their lawlessness.

verses.text: The righteous Lord cut apart the necks of sinners.
verses.display_text:
The righteous Lord cut apart
the necks of sinners.

verses.text: May all who hate Zion be put to shame and turn backward.
verses.display_text:
May all who hate Zion
be put to shame and turn backward.

verses.text: May they become like grass on roofs, which dried up before it was pulled out,
verses.display_text:
May they become like grass on roofs,
which dried up before it was pulled out,

verses.text: with which no reaper has filled his hand, nor the one gathering sheaves his bosom,
verses.display_text:
with which no reaper has filled his hand,
nor the one gathering sheaves his bosom,

verses.text: And passersby have not said, “The Lord’s blessing be upon you; we have blessed you in the Lord’s name.”
A song of the ascents. From the depths I have cried unto Thee, Lord.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
From the depths I have cried unto Thee, Lord.

verses.text: Lord, hear my voice; let Thine ears be attentive to the voice of my petition.
If Thou dost closely watch lawless deeds, Lord, Lord, who will withstand?
verses.display_text:
If Thou dost closely watch lawless deeds, Lord,
Lord, who will withstand?

verses.text: For with Thee is atonement.
verses.display_text: For with Thee is atonement.

verses.text: Because of Thy law I waited for Thee, Lord; my soul waited for Thy word.
verses.display_text:
Because of Thy law I waited for Thee, Lord;
my soul waited for Thy word.

verses.text: My soul hoped in the Lord from the morning watch until night; from the morning watch let Israel hope in the Lord.
For with the Lord is mercy, and with Him is abundant redemption,
verses.display_text:
For with the Lord is mercy,
and with Him is abundant redemption,

verses.text: And He will redeem Israel from all its lawless deeds.
verses.display_text:
And He will redeem Israel
from all its lawless deeds.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. For David. Lord, my heart was not exalted, nor were my eyes raised high; I did not walk among great things nor among wonders beyond me.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents. For David.
Lord, my heart was not exalted,
nor were my eyes raised high;
I did not walk among great things
nor among wonders beyond me.

verses.text: If I was not humble-minded, but exalted my soul— like the weaned child upon its mother, like repayment upon my soul.
verses.display_text:
If I was not humble-minded,
but exalted my soul—
like the weaned child upon its mother,
like repayment upon my soul.

verses.text: Let Israel hope in the Lord, from now and for ever.
verses.display_text:
Let Israel hope in the Lord,
from now and for ever.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. Remember David, Lord, and all his gentleness,
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
Remember David, Lord,
and all his gentleness,

verses.text: how he swore to the Lord, vowed to the God of Jacob:
verses.display_text:
how he swore to the Lord,
vowed to the God of Jacob:

verses.text: “I will not enter the dwelling of my house, nor climb onto my bed’s couch;
verses.display_text:
“I will not enter the dwelling of my house,
nor climb onto my bed’s couch;

verses.text: I will not give sleep to my eyes, slumber to my eyelids, or rest to my temples,
verses.display_text:
I will not give sleep to my eyes,
slumber to my eyelids,
or rest to my temples,

verses.text: until I find a place for the Lord, a dwelling for the God of Jacob.”
verses.display_text:
until I find a place for the Lord,
a dwelling for the God of Jacob.”

verses.text: Behold, we heard of her in Ephrathah; we found her in the plains of the forest.
verses.display_text:
Behold, we heard of her in Ephrathah;
we found her in the plains of the forest.

verses.text: We will enter His dwelling places; we will bow toward the place where His feet stood.
verses.display_text:
We will enter His dwelling places;
we will bow toward the place where His feet stood.

verses.text: Rise, Lord, to Thy rest, Thou and the ark of Thy holiness.
verses.display_text:
Rise, Lord, to Thy rest,
Thou and the ark of Thy holiness.

verses.text: Thy priests will clothe themselves in righteousness, and Thy holy ones will exult.
verses.display_text:
Thy priests will clothe themselves in righteousness,
and Thy holy ones will exult.

verses.text: For the sake of David Thy slave, do not turn away the face of Thine anointed.
verses.display_text:
For the sake of David Thy slave,
do not turn away the face of Thine anointed.

verses.text: The Lord swore truth to David, and He will certainly not annul it: “From the fruit of your belly I will set one on your throne.
verses.display_text:
The Lord swore truth to David, and He will certainly not annul it:
“From the fruit of your belly I will set one on your throne.

verses.text: If your sons keep My covenant and these testimonies of Mine that I will teach them, their sons too will sit for ever on your throne.”
verses.display_text:
If your sons keep My covenant
and these testimonies of Mine that I will teach them,
their sons too will sit for ever on your throne.”

verses.text: For the Lord chose Zion; He selected her as His dwelling:
verses.display_text:
For the Lord chose Zion;
He selected her as His dwelling:

verses.text: “This is My rest for age upon age; here I will dwell, for I selected her.
verses.display_text:
“This is My rest for age upon age;
here I will dwell, for I selected her.

verses.text: I will surely bless her game; I will satisfy her poor with loaves.
verses.display_text:
I will surely bless her game;
I will satisfy her poor with loaves.

verses.text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her holy ones will surely exult.
verses.display_text:
I will clothe her priests with salvation,
and her holy ones will surely exult.

verses.text: There I will make a horn spring up for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.
verses.display_text:
There I will make a horn spring up for David;
I have prepared a lamp for My anointed.

verses.text: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but upon him My holy sign will blossom.”
verses.display_text:
I will clothe his enemies with shame,
but upon him My holy sign will blossom.”

verses.text: A song of the ascents. For David. Behold, what is good or what is delightful except for brothers to dwell together?
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents. For David.
Behold, what is good or what is delightful
except for brothers to dwell together?

verses.text: Like ointment upon the head, descending upon the beard, Aaron’s beard, descending upon the border of his garment;
Like Hermon’s dew descending upon Zion’s mountains; for there the Lord commanded the blessing and life for ever.
verses.display_text:
Like Hermon’s dew
descending upon Zion’s mountains;
for there the Lord commanded the blessing
and life for ever.

verses.text: A song of the ascents. Behold, bless the Lord, all slaves of the Lord, who stand in the Lord’s house, in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.display_text:
A song of the ascents.
Behold, bless the Lord, all slaves of the Lord,
who stand in the Lord’s house,
in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.text: By night lift your hands toward the holy places and bless the Lord.
verses.display_text:
By night lift your hands toward the holy places
and bless the Lord.

verses.text: The Lord will bless you from Zion, who made heaven and earth.
verses.display_text:
The Lord will bless you from Zion,
who made heaven and earth.

verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the Lord’s name; praise the Lord, slaves,
you who stand in the Lord’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
verses.display_text:
you who stand in the Lord’s house,
in the courts of our God’s house.

verses.text: Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good; make music to His name, for it is beautiful.
verses.display_text:
Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good;
make music to His name, for it is beautiful.

verses.text: For the Lord chose Jacob for Himself, Israel as His special possession.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord chose Jacob for Himself,
Israel as His special possession.

verses.text: For I knew that the Lord is great, and our Lord is above all the gods.
verses.display_text:
For I knew that the Lord is great,
and our Lord is above all the gods.

verses.text: Everything the Lord willed, He did, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all the deeps.
verses.display_text:
Everything the Lord willed, He did,
in heaven and on earth,
in the seas and all the deeps.

verses.text: He brings clouds up from the earth’s extremity; He made lightning for rain; He brings winds out of His treasuries.
He struck Egypt’s firstborn, from man to beast.
verses.display_text:
He struck Egypt’s firstborn,
from man to beast.

verses.text: He sent out signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, upon Pharaoh and all his slaves.
verses.display_text:
He sent out signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt,
upon Pharaoh and all his slaves.

verses.text: He struck many nations and killed powerful kings,
verses.display_text:
He struck many nations
and killed powerful kings,

verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all Canaan’s kingdoms.
verses.display_text:
Sihon king of the Amorites,
Og king of Bashan,
and all Canaan’s kingdoms.

verses.text: He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.
verses.display_text:
He gave their land as an inheritance,
an inheritance to Israel His people.

verses.text: Lord, Thy name is for ever; Lord, Thy memorial is from generation to generation.
verses.display_text:
Lord, Thy name is for ever;
Lord, Thy memorial is from generation to generation.

verses.text: For the Lord will judge His people and be comforted concerning His slaves.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord will judge His people
and be comforted concerning His slaves.

verses.text: The nations’ idols are silver and gold, works of human hands.
verses.display_text:
The nations’ idols are silver and gold,
works of human hands.

verses.text: They have a mouth but will not speak; they have eyes but will not see.
verses.display_text:
They have a mouth but will not speak;
they have eyes but will not see.

verses.text: They have ears but will not listen; they have noses but will not smell; they have hands but will not touch; they have feet but will not walk; they will not sound in their throat, for there is no breath in their mouth.
May those who make them become like them, and all who trust in them.
verses.display_text:
May those who make them become like them,
and all who trust in them.

verses.text: House of Israel, bless the Lord; house of Aaron, bless the Lord.
verses.display_text:
House of Israel, bless the Lord;
house of Aaron, bless the Lord.

verses.text: House of Levi, bless the Lord; you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
verses.display_text:
House of Levi, bless the Lord;
you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord from Zion, He who dwells in Jerusalem.
verses.display_text:
Blessed be the Lord from Zion,
He who dwells in Jerusalem.

verses.text: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the Lord, for He is kind; for His mercy is for ever.
Give thanks to the God of gods; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
Give thanks to the God of gods;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
Give thanks to the Lord of lords;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: To Him who alone does great wonders; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
To Him who alone does great wonders;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: To Him who made the heavens with understanding; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
To Him who made the heavens with understanding;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: To Him who made the earth firm upon the waters; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
To Him who made the earth firm upon the waters;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: To Him who alone made great lights; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
To Him who alone made great lights;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: the sun for authority over the day; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
the sun for authority over the day;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: the moon and stars for authority over the night; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
the moon and stars for authority over the night;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: To Him who struck Egypt with their firstborn; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
To Him who struck Egypt with their firstborn;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: And to Him who brought Israel out from their midst; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
And to Him who brought Israel out from their midst;

verses.text: with a mighty hand and a raised arm; for His mercy is for ever.

with a mighty hand and a raised arm;

verses.display_text:
To Him who divided the Red Sea into divisions;

verses.display_text:
And to Him who led Israel through its midst;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: And to Him who shook Pharaoh and his force into the Red Sea; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
And to Him who shook Pharaoh and his force into the Red Sea;

verses.text: To Him who led His people through the wilderness; for His mercy is for ever. To Him who brought water out of a sheer rock; for His mercy is for ever.
To Him who struck great kings; for His mercy is for ever.

To Him who struck great kings;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: And to Him who killed mighty kings; for His mercy is for ever.

Sihon king of the Amorites;

and Og king of Bashan;

verses.text: an inheritance to Israel His slave; for His mercy is for ever.

an inheritance to Israel His slave;

verses.text: For in our humiliation the Lord remembered us; for His mercy is for ever.

For in our humiliation the Lord remembered us;
for His mercy is for ever.

verses.text: And He redeemed us from our enemies; for His mercy is for ever.
verses.display_text:
And He redeemed us from our enemies;

He gives food to all flesh;

verses.text: Give thanks to the God of heaven; for His mercy is for ever. Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for His mercy is for ever.

For David.
By Babylon’s rivers, there we sat and wept
when we remembered Zion.

Upon the willows in her midst

For there those who took us captive asked us for words of songs,

How can we sing the Lord’s song

If I forget you, Jerusalem,
may my right hand be forgotten.

those saying, “Empty her, empty her,

happy is the one who will repay you

Happy is the one who will seize your infants

I will thank Thee, Lord, with all my heart,
for Thou heardest the words of my mouth,
and before angels I will make music unto Thee.

verses.display_text:
I will bow toward Thy holy temple
and thank Thy name for Thy mercy and Thy truth,
for Thou hast magnified Thine utterance above every name.

verses.text: On whatever day I call Thee, hear me quickly; Thou wilt greatly attend to me with strength in my soul.
verses.display_text:
On whatever day I call Thee, hear me quickly;
Thou wilt greatly attend to me with strength in my soul.

verses.display_text:
Let all earth’s kings thank Thee, Lord,
for they heard all the words of Thy mouth.

verses.text: And let them sing in the Lord’s ways, for great is the Lord’s glory.
verses.display_text:
And let them sing in the Lord’s ways,
for great is the Lord’s glory.

verses.text: For the Lord is high and watches the lowly, and the lofty He knows from afar.
verses.display_text:
For the Lord is high and watches the lowly,
and the lofty He knows from afar.

verses.text: If I walk amid affliction, Thou wilt keep me alive; against my enemies’ anger Thou didst stretch out Thy hand, and Thy right hand saved me.
The Lord will repay on my behalf. Lord, Thy mercy is for ever; do not neglect the works of Thy hands.
For the end. A psalm for David. Lord, Thou didst test me and know me.

For the end. A psalm for David.

verses.display_text:
Thou knewest my sitting and my rising;

verses.text: Thou didst trace my path and my measuring cord, and Thou didst foresee all my ways.
verses.display_text:

and Thou didst foresee all my ways.

verses.text: For there is no word on my tongue,
verses.display_text: For there is no word on my tongue,

verses.display_text:

verses.display_text:

verses.text: Where can I go from Thy Spirit, and where can I flee from Thy face?
verses.display_text:
Where can I go from Thy Spirit,

verses.display_text:
If I ascend to heaven, Thou art there;
if I descend into Hades, Thou art present.

if I take up my wings at dawn
and settle at the sea’s farthest reaches,

verses.display_text:
indeed, even there Thy hand will guide me,

verses.display_text:

verses.display_text:
For Thou didst acquire my kidneys, Lord;
Thou didst support me from my mother’s womb.

verses.text: I will thank Thee, for I was made fearfully wonderful; wondrous are Thy works, and my soul knows very well.

verses.display_text:
My bone was not hidden from Thee, which Thou madest in secret,
and my substance in earth’s lowest places.

verses.display_text:
Thy friends were greatly honored by me, God;
their beginnings grew very strong.

verses.text: I will count them, and they will multiply beyond the sand; I awoke, and I am still with Thee.
verses.display_text:
I will count them, and they will multiply beyond the sand;
